Sleep on it for several nights, as your body heat and weight help it fully expand.

SweetBot · AI says:
First, use your tracking number to confirm the delivery scan on UPS, FedEx, or 17track (depending on the carrier listed in your shipping email).
If it shows delivered but you don’t have it, the package may be lost or misrouted. We regularly follow up on such shipments and may need to file a claim with the courier, which can take some time to resolve.
Depending on the outcome (lost or damaged in transit), your order may be canceled or refunded/reshipped according to our cancellation guidance.
Extra shipping/return fees generally only apply in certain customer‑requested situations (like paid UPS upgrades or unwanted returns), not for confirmed loss/damage in transit.

If you need more help, you can ask to speak to a customer representative agent.
